/* dashboard.xml.selectDashboardStats */ SELECT -- 오늘 가입 (idx_sys_user_crt_date — crt_date 범위, ::date 래핑 없음) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_USER WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND crt_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') AS todaySignups,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_USER WHERE del_yn = 'N') AS totalUsers,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM sys_user_login_log WHERE login_date >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND login_date < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day', 'YYYYMMDD')) AS todayLogins,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND crt_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND crt_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') AS todayPosts,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GUILD_APPLICATION WHERE crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND crt_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') AS todayGuildApplications

/* dashboard.xml.selectDailyStats */ SELECT TO_CHAR(date_range.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(user_stats.signups, 0) AS signups, COALESCE(login_stats.logins, 0) AS logins, COALESCE(post_stats.posts, 0) AS posts, COALESCE(guild_stats.guildApplications, 0) AS guildApplications FROM ( SELECT (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * seq.seq) AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 ) seq ) date_range LEFT JOIN ( SELECT crt_date::date AS date, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM SYS_USER WHERE crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY crt_date::date ) user_stats ON date_range.date = user_stats.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTRING(login_date, 1, 8)::date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS logins FROM sys_user_login_log WHERE login_date >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY SUBSTRING(login_date, 1, 8)::date ) login_stats ON date_range.date = login_stats.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT crt_date::date AS date, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM ( SELECT crt_date FROM NOTICE WHERE crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT crt_date FROM INQUIRY WHERE crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND del_yn = 'N' ) combined_posts GROUP BY crt_date::date ) post_stats ON date_range.date = post_stats.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT crt_date::date AS date, COUNT(*) AS guildApplications FROM GUILD_APPLICATION WHERE crt_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY crt_date::date ) guild_stats ON date_range.date = guild_stats.date -- 차트·표는 왼쪽=과거 → 오른쪽=최근(시간 순)이 자연스러움 ORDER BY date_range.date ASC
